test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A student scored 80/80 marks in term 1 and 75/90 marks in term 2. What will be his percentage of final score, if the weightage given to the terms is 40% and 60%, respectively. (correct to the nearest integer)
solution:
**Given:**

Marks scored in term 1 is 80/80 

Marks scored in term 2 is 75/90 

Weightage given is 40% and 60%

**Calculation:**

Here, in term 1 marks scored out of 80 = 80 

Weightage given is 40% 

Marks in term 1 = 80 × 40/100 = 32

Marks scored = 80 × 40/100 = 32 

Also, in term 2 marks scored out of 90 = 75 

Weightage given is 60% 

Marks in term 2 = 90 × 60/100 = 54

Marks scored = 75 × 60/100 = 45

Total marks in term 1 + term 2 = 32 + 54 = 86

Total marks scored by the student = 32 + 45 = 77 

Percentage secured by student = (77/86)× 100 = 89.53%

So, the nearest integer is 90% 

**Hence, the required percentage is 90% .**
